{{Quote|I saw your laser sword. Only Jedis carry that kind of weapon.''"<br />"''Perhaps I killed a Jedi and took it from him.|Anakin Skywalker and Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="Episode I" />}}
'''Qui-Gon Jinn's lightsaber''' was wielded by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. It was constructed after the [[Telosian Civil War]].<ref name="Dark Side 5" />

The lightsaber saw action on many fronts, including [[New Apsolon/Legends|New Apsolon]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]], [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]], [[Asmeru/Legends|Asmeru]], [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]], and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. After Jinn was [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|mortally wounded]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] used it to defeat [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].<ref name="Episode I" />

Kenobi adopted the lightsaber as his own for a time,<ref name="Rogue Planet">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref> before replacing it with a new [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's second lightsaber/Legends|self-built lightsaber]].<ref name="Jedi Quest 2">[[Jedi Quest 2|''Jedi Quest'' 2]]</ref>.

==Description==
While Jinn was identified as a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]] in the Order, he did not use the traditional blue focusing crystals that Guardians typically used in their sabers and instead utilized a set of green focusing [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] that were typically used in the sabers of [[Jedi Consular]]s. The [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] had a highly elaborate design, using multiple small [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] to create a scalloped handgrip. It also used microscopic circuitry to govern the nature of the blade.<ref name="EP1VD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==History==
===Creation and early usage===
[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] constructed this lightsaber after losing his [[Qui-Gon Jinn's first lightsaber|previous]] one on a mission to [[Telos IV]], the [[Planet/Legends|homeworld]] of his former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Xanatos]].<ref name="Dark Side 5" /> Jinn used the lightsaber in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]] in a [[Mission to Bandomeer|duel]] on [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]] against Xanatos twice, first alone, and then with the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. After Xanatos fled the duel and the planet, Jinn took Kenobi as his third and final apprentice. On a mission to [[Phindar/Legends|Phindar]], Jinn continued to use the lightsaber as well as on the world of [[Gala]] where he used it in a duel against [[Lonnag Giba]].

===Later missions===
Jinn would also use this lightsaber on [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]] and within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], where he engaged in a lightsaber [[Incident at the Jedi Temple|duel]] with Xanatos once again. On Telos, he used it against Xanatos once again, with the end result being Xanatos's suicide. Jinn wielded the lightsaber on the satellite of [[Centax-2/Legends|Centax-2]] against [[Tarrence Chenati]]'s rain of blaster bolts alongside his friend, [[Tahl]].

===Stark Hyperspace War===
In that same year, Jinn used the lightsaber during the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]] alongside [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Tyvokka/Legends|Tyvokka]], [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]], [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], and Kenobi. In the ensuring years following the war, he used the lightsaber on [[Rutan/Legends|Rutan]], [[Frego]], [[New Apsolon/Legends|New Apsolon]] and [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].

===Yinchorri and Nebula Front crises===
In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], Jinn used the weapon in the [[Yinchorri Uprising]], participating in the [[Battle of Yinchorr]] alongside Kenobi, [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]]. On a mission to the world of [[Asmeru/Legends|Asmeru]] with Kenobi, [[Vergere]], [[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]], [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], and [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]], Jinn used the lightsaber in a pitched [[Mission to Asmeru|battle]] against the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]], and later during the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]].

===Invasion of Naboo===
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], this lightsaber was most notably used during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. Jinn [[Duel on Tatooine/Legends|dueled]] against the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and later used the weapon in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Second Battle of Theed]], where, with his apprentice, he dueled Darth Maul once more, resulting in his own death. After Jinn was impaled by Maul, Kenobi and Maul fought one-on-one. When the Sith Lord knocked the Padawan down a reactor pit and causing Kenobi to grab an input nozzle to prevent falling to his death, Maul kicked Kenobi's lightsaber into the pit. This forced Kenobi to improvise and use the Force to launch himself out of the of the pit and call Jinn's saber, using it to bisect Maul.<ref name="Episode I" />

As a result of his weapon being lost in the duel, Kenobi took possession of his master's lightsaber for a time, using it on [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] in [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]].<ref name="Rogue Planet"/> By [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]], Kenobi had discontinued using it,<ref name="Jedi Quest 2" /> having constructed [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's second lightsaber/Legends|a new lightsaber]] for himself, identical to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's first lightsaber/Legends|the first]] that he had lost on Naboo.<ref name="Guide" /> At some point, Anakin Skywalker wielded Qui-Gon's lightsaber until he eventually constructed his own [[Anakin Skywalker's first lightsaber/Legends|weapon]].<ref name="SkyeWalkers" /> Qui-Gon's lightsaber was ultimately kept in a memorial within the Jedi Temple.<ref name="Guide" />
